relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: Studied Greek literature and linguistics at Athens in 1926-31

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: Studied Greek literature and linguistics at Athens in 1926-31 (under Hatzidakis)

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: In 1934-46 worked as lexicographic compiler at Greek Academy.

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: From 1938 further studies at Berlin and completed Ph.D. in IE and Classics in 1942.

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: In 1943-44 Assistant of Indology at Berlin.

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: in 1948 taught Greek at University of Chicago

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: 1949-51 Biblical languages at McCornick Theological Seminary, Chicago

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: 1953-59 IE linguistics at University of Utah.

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: In 1959-78 Professor of Linguistics at University of North Dakota in Grand Forks, then emeritus.

relations.subject: Demetrios I. Georgakas
relations.evidence: Married Barbara Williams (Associate Professor of Greek).
